    RAG & Embeddings Reference¶

    This section documents the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline, document chunk representation, vector store backends, and embedding generators.

    @dataclass(slots=True)
class DocumentChunk:
    """
    Standardized knowledge chunk retrieved from any vector database.
    """
    id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    title: str = ""
    text: str = ""
    score: float = 0.0
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    audio_url: str | None = None
    vector_store: str = "Unknown"

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Converts chunk to dictionary representation."""
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "title": self.title,
            "text": self.text,
            "score": self.score,
            "metadata": self.metadata,
            "audio_url": self.audio_url,
            "vector_store": self.vector_store,
        }

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> DocumentChunk:
        """Constructs a DocumentChunk from dictionary data."""
        return cls(
            id=str(data.get("id", str(uuid.uuid4()))),
            title=str(data.get("title", "")),
            text=str(data.get("text", "")),
            score=float(data.get("score", 0.0)),
            metadata=dict(data.get("metadata", {})),
            audio_url=data.get("audio_url"),
            vector_store=str(data.get("vector_store", "Unknown")),
        )

    class RAGRetriever:
    """
    Modular RAG retrieval engine.
    Connects any embedding model with primary and fallback vector stores.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        embedding_model: BaseEmbeddingModel,
        vector_store: BaseVectorStore,
        fallback_store: BaseVectorStore | None = None,
        default_limit: int = 3,
        default_score_threshold: float = 0.45,
        query_normalizer: Callable[[str], str] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.embedding_model = embedding_model
        self.vector_store = vector_store
        self.fallback_store = fallback_store
        self.default_limit = default_limit
        self.default_score_threshold = default_score_threshold
        self.query_normalizer = query_normalizer

    async def retrieve(
        self,
        query: str,
        limit: int | None = None,
        score_threshold: float | None = None,
        filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
        """
        Retrieves relevant document chunks for a natural language voice query.
        Falls back to fallback_store if primary store is unreachable or yields no matches.
        """
        clean_query = (query or "").strip()
        if not clean_query:
            return []

        if self.query_normalizer is not None:
            try:
                clean_query = self.query_normalizer(clean_query)
            except Exception as norm_err:
                print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Query normalizer error: {norm_err}")

        lim = limit if limit is not None else self.default_limit
        thresh = score_threshold if score_threshold is not None else self.default_score_threshold

        # 1. Generate query embedding vector
        query_vector: list[float] = []
        try:
            query_vector = await self.embedding_model.embed_query(clean_query)
        except Exception as emb_err:
            print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Embedding generation error: {emb_err}")

        # 2. Search primary vector store
        matches: list[DocumentChunk] = []
        if query_vector:
            try:
                matches = await self.vector_store.search(
                    query_vector=query_vector,
                    limit=lim,
                    score_threshold=thresh,
                    filter_metadata=filter_metadata,
                )
            except Exception as store_err:
                print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Primary store error ({self.vector_store.name}): {store_err}")

        # 3. Fallback to secondary store if primary returned no matches
        if not matches and self.fallback_store is not None:
            print(f"ℹ️  [RAGRetriever] Querying fallback store: {self.fallback_store.name}")
            try:
                if query_vector:
                    matches = await self.fallback_store.search(
                        query_vector=query_vector,
                        limit=lim,
                        score_threshold=thresh,
                        filter_metadata=filter_metadata,
                    )
                # If still no matches and fallback is InMemoryVectorStore, try keyword search
                if not matches and isinstance(self.fallback_store, InMemoryVectorStore):
                    matches = self.fallback_store.search_keyword(clean_query, limit=lim)
            except Exception as fb_err:
                print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Fallback store error ({self.fallback_store.name}): {fb_err}")

        return matches

    def build_context_text(
        self,
        matches: list[DocumentChunk],
        header: str | None = None,
        footer: str | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Formats retrieved chunks into a standardized context block for LLM prompts."""
        if not matches:
            return ""
        blocks = [f"- [{m.title}]: {m.text}" for m in matches if m.text]
        content = "\n\n".join(blocks)
        parts = []
        if header:
            parts.append(header)
        parts.append(content)
        if footer:
            parts.append(footer)
        return "\n\n".join(parts)

    async def __call__(
        self,
        query: str,
        limit: int | None = None,
        score_threshold: float | None = None,
        filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Callable interface directly compatible with KnowledgeBaseTool's retriever_func.
        Returns list of dicts.
        """
        chunks = await self.retrieve(
            query=query,
            limit=limit,
            score_threshold=score_threshold,
            filter_metadata=filter_metadata,
        )
        return [c.to_dict() for c in chunks]

    self,

    score_threshold: float | None = None,
    filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
    """
    Retrieves relevant document chunks for a natural language voice query.
    Falls back to fallback_store if primary store is unreachable or yields no matches.
    """
    clean_query = (query or "").strip()

        return []

    if self.query_normalizer is not None:
        try:
            clean_query = self.query_normalizer(clean_query)
        except Exception as norm_err:
            print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Query normalizer error: {norm_err}")

    lim = limit if limit is not None else self.default_limit
    thresh = score_threshold if score_threshold is not None else self.default_score_threshold

    # 1. Generate query embedding vector
    query_vector: list[float] = []
    try:
        query_vector = await self.embedding_model.embed_query(clean_query)
    except Exception as emb_err:
        print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Embedding generation error: {emb_err}")

    # 2. Search primary vector store
    matches: list[DocumentChunk] = []
    if query_vector:
        try:
            matches = await self.vector_store.search(
                query_vector=query_vector,
                limit=lim,
                score_threshold=thresh,
                filter_metadata=filter_metadata,
            )
        except Exception as store_err:
            print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Primary store error ({self.vector_store.name}): {store_err}")

    # 3. Fallback to secondary store if primary returned no matches
    if not matches and self.fallback_store is not None:
        print(f"ℹ️  [RAGRetriever] Querying fallback store: {self.fallback_store.name}")
        try:
            if query_vector:
                matches = await self.fallback_store.search(
                    query_vector=query_vector,
                    limit=lim,
                    score_threshold=thresh,
                    filter_metadata=filter_metadata,
                )
            # If still no matches and fallback is InMemoryVectorStore, try keyword search
            if not matches and isinstance(self.fallback_store, InMemoryVectorStore):
                matches = self.fallback_store.search_keyword(clean_query, limit=lim)
        except Exception as fb_err:
            print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Fallback store error ({self.fallback_store.name}): {fb_err}")

    return matches

    class BaseVectorStore(ABC):
    """
    Abstract Base Class for vector storage and semantic retrieval backends.
    """

    @property
    @abstractmethod
    def name(self) -> str:
        """Name of the vector database backend (e.g. In-Memory, Qdrant, Pinecone)."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def search(
        self,
        query_vector: list[float],
        limit: int = 3,
        score_threshold: float = 0.5,
        filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
        """
        Searches the vector store using dense query vectors.
        Returns matched DocumentChunks ranked by descending similarity score.
        """
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def upsert(
        self,
        chunks: list[DocumentChunk],
        vectors: list[list[float]],
    ) -> None:
        """Stores or updates document chunks with their dense vector embeddings."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def is_available(self) -> bool:
        """Returns True if the backend is reachable and ready to serve queries."""
        pass

    async def get_stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Returns collection/index statistics (point counts, dimensions, status)."""
        available = await self.is_available()
        return {
            "status": "online" if available else "offline",
            "name": self.name,
            "points_count": 0,
            "vectors_count": 0,
        }

    async def delete_points(self, point_ids: list[str]) -> int:
        """Deletes specific point IDs from the vector store."""
        return 0

    async def delete_by_filter(self, filter_metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Deletes documents matching the specified metadata filter."""
        return False

    async def init_collection(self) -> bool:
        """Ensures the collection or index exists, creating it if required."""
        return True

    class InMemoryVectorStore(BaseVectorStore):
    """
    In-memory vector store with optional JSON persistence.
    """

    def __init__(self, name: str = "In-Memory Store") -> None:
        self._name = name
        self._chunks: list[DocumentChunk] = []
        self._vectors: list[list[float]] = []

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return self._name

    async def is_available(self) -> bool:
        return True

    async def get_stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Returns statistics of in-memory store."""
        return {
            "status": "online",
            "name": self.name,
            "points_count": len(self._chunks),
            "vectors_count": len(self._vectors),
        }

    async def delete_points(self, point_ids: list[str]) -> int:
        """Deletes points by ID."""
        id_set = set(point_ids)
        new_chunks = []
        new_vectors = []
        deleted = 0
        for c, v in zip(self._chunks, self._vectors):
            if c.id in id_set:
                deleted += 1
            else:
                new_chunks.append(c)
                new_vectors.append(v)
        self._chunks = new_chunks
        self._vectors = new_vectors
        return deleted

    async def delete_by_filter(self, filter_metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Deletes chunks matching filter."""
        new_chunks = []
        new_vectors = []
        for c, v in zip(self._chunks, self._vectors):
            match = True
            for k, val in filter_metadata.items():
                if c.metadata.get(k) != val:
                    match = False
                    break
            if not match:
                new_chunks.append(c)
                new_vectors.append(v)
        self._chunks = new_chunks
        self._vectors = new_vectors
        return True

    async def upsert(
        self,
        chunks: list[DocumentChunk],
        vectors: list[list[float]],
    ) -> None:
        """Stores chunks with their corresponding vectors."""
        for c, v in zip(chunks, vectors):
            c.vector_store = self.name
            self._chunks.append(c)
            self._vectors.append(v)

    async def search(
        self,
        query_vector: list[float],
        limit: int = 3,
        score_threshold: float = 0.5,
        filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
        """Performs cosine similarity search against stored vectors."""
        if not self._chunks:
            return []

        # If query vector is empty or all zeros, return empty (or let keyword search handle)
        if not query_vector or all(v == 0.0 for v in query_vector):
            return []

        results: list[tuple[float, DocumentChunk]] = []

        for chunk, vec in zip(self._chunks, self._vectors):
            # Check metadata filter
            if filter_metadata:
                match = True
                for k, v in filter_metadata.items():
                    if chunk.metadata.get(k) != v:
                        match = False
                        break
                if not match:
                    continue

            score = cosine_similarity(query_vector, vec)
            if score >= score_threshold:
                match_chunk = DocumentChunk(
                    id=chunk.id,
                    title=chunk.title,
                    text=chunk.text,
                    score=round(score, 4),
                    metadata=chunk.metadata,
                    audio_url=chunk.audio_url,
                    vector_store=self.name,
                )
                results.append((score, match_chunk))

        # Sort descending by score
        results.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
        return [chunk for _, chunk in results[:limit]]

    def search_keyword(
        self,
        query: str,
        limit: int = 3,
    ) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
        """
        Fast token-based lexical search fallback when embeddings are unavailable.
        """
        if not query or not self._chunks:
            return []

        words = [w.lower() for w in query.strip().split() if len(w) > 1]
        if not words:
            return []

        scored: list[tuple[int, DocumentChunk]] = []
        for chunk in self._chunks:
            haystack = f"{chunk.title} {chunk.text}".lower()
            match_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in haystack)
            if match_count > 0:
                scored.append((match_count, chunk))

        scored.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
        return [
            DocumentChunk(
                id=c.id,
                title=c.title,
                text=c.text,
                score=round(score / max(len(words), 1), 2),
                metadata=c.metadata,
                audio_url=c.audio_url,
                vector_store=f"{self.name} (Keyword)",
            )
            for score, c in scored[:limit]
        ]

    @classmethod
    def from_json_file(cls, filepath: str) -> InMemoryVectorStore:
        """
        Loads document chunks and vectors from a structured JSON file.
        Accepts list of dictionaries with {title, text, metadata, audio_url, vector?}.
        """
        store = cls(name=f"JSON Store ({os.path.basename(filepath)})")
        if not os.path.isfile(filepath):
            return store

        try:
            with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)

            items = data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get("records", [])
            for item in items:
                chunk = DocumentChunk(
                    title=item.get("title", ""),
                    text=item.get("text", "") or item.get("content", ""),
                    metadata=item.get("metadata", {}),
                    audio_url=item.get("audio_url"),
                    vector_store=store.name,
                )
                vec = item.get("vector") or item.get("embedding") or []
                store._chunks.append(chunk)
                store._vectors.append(vec if isinstance(vec, list) else [])
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [InMemoryVectorStore] Error loading {filepath}: {exc}")

        return store

    class QdrantVectorStore(BaseVectorStore):
    """
    Qdrant vector database store adapter.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        collection_name: str = "knowledge_base",
        url: str | None = None,
        host: str = "localhost",
        port: int = 6333,
        api_key: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.collection_name = collection_name
        self.url = url or os.environ.get("QDRANT_URL", f"http://{host}:{port}")
        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("QDRANT_API_KEY")
        self._client: Any = None

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return f"Qdrant ({self.collection_name})"

    def _get_client(self) -> Any:
        if not QDRANT_AVAILABLE or AsyncQdrantClient is None:
            return None
        if self._client is None:
            self._client = AsyncQdrantClient(url=self.url, api_key=self.api_key, timeout=5, check_compatibility=False)
        return self._client

    async def is_available(self) -> bool:
        """Checks if Qdrant server is reachable and collection exists."""
        client = self._get_client()
        if client is None:
            return False
        try:
            collections = await client.get_collections()
            return any(c.name == self.collection_name for c in collections.collections)
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def init_collection(self, vector_size: int = 768, distance: str = "Cosine") -> bool:
        """Ensures the collection exists with the required vector dimension and distance metric."""
        client = self._get_client()
        if client is None or qmodels is None:
            return False
        try:
            collections = await client.get_collections()
            existing = [c.name for c in collections.collections]
            if self.collection_name not in existing:
                dist_metric = qmodels.Distance.COSINE
                if distance.lower() == "euclid":
                    dist_metric = qmodels.Distance.EUCLID
                elif distance.lower() == "dot":
                    dist_metric = qmodels.Distance.DOT

                await client.create_collection(
                    collection_name=self.collection_name,
                    vectors_config=qmodels.VectorParams(
                        size=vector_size,
                        distance=dist_metric,
                    ),
                )
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [QdrantVectorStore] Collection init skipped/error: {exc}")
            return False

    async def get_stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Retrieves collection statistics (point counts, indexed vectors, dimension)."""
        client = self._get_client()
        if client is None or not await self.is_available():
            return {
                "status": "offline",
                "collection_name": self.collection_name,
                "points_count": 0,
                "vectors_count": 0,
            }
        try:
            info = await client.get_collection(collection_name=self.collection_name)
            points = getattr(info, "points_count", 0) or 0
            vectors = getattr(info, "indexed_vectors_count", points) or points
            vector_size = 768
            distance = "Cosine"
            try:
                if hasattr(info.config.params, "vectors"):
                    v_params = info.config.params.vectors
                    if hasattr(v_params, "size"):
                        vector_size = v_params.size
                    if hasattr(v_params, "distance"):
                        distance = str(v_params.distance.value if hasattr(v_params.distance, "value") else v_params.distance)
            except Exception:
                pass

            return {
                "status": "online",
                "collection_name": self.collection_name,
                "points_count": points,
                "vectors_count": vectors,
                "vector_size": vector_size,
                "distance": distance,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            return {"status": "error", "error": str(exc), "points_count": 0}

    async def delete_points(self, point_ids: list[str]) -> int:
        """Deletes specific point IDs from Qdrant."""
        if not point_ids or qmodels is None:
            return 0
        client = self._get_client()
        if client is None:
            return 0
        try:
            await client.delete(
                collection_name=self.collection_name,
                points_selector=qmodels.PointIdsList(points=point_ids),
            )
            return len(point_ids)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [QdrantVectorStore] Delete points error: {exc}")
            return 0

    async def delete_by_filter(self, filter_metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Deletes all points matching the given metadata filter."""
        if not filter_metadata or qmodels is None:
            return False
        client = self._get_client()
        if client is None:
            return False
        try:
            conditions: list[Any] = [
                qmodels.FieldCondition(key=k, match=qmodels.MatchValue(value=v))
                for k, v in filter_metadata.items()
            ]
            await client.delete(
                collection_name=self.collection_name,
                points_selector=qmodels.FilterSelector(
                    filter=qmodels.Filter(must=conditions)
                ),
            )
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [QdrantVectorStore] Delete by filter error: {exc}")
            return False

    async def search(
        self,
        query_vector: list[float],
        limit: int = 3,
        score_threshold: float = 0.5,
        filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
        """Executes vector similarity search on Qdrant collection."""
        client = self._get_client()
        if client is None:
            return []

        q_filter = None
        if filter_metadata and qmodels is not None:
            must_conditions: list[Any] = []
            should_conditions: list[Any] = []
            for k, v in filter_metadata.items():
                if isinstance(v, list):
                    for item in v:
                        should_conditions.append(qmodels.FieldCondition(key=k, match=qmodels.MatchValue(value=item)))
                else:
                    must_conditions.append(qmodels.FieldCondition(key=k, match=qmodels.MatchValue(value=v)))

            if must_conditions and should_conditions:
                q_filter = qmodels.Filter(must=must_conditions, should=should_conditions)
            elif should_conditions:
                q_filter = qmodels.Filter(should=should_conditions)
            elif must_conditions:
                q_filter = qmodels.Filter(must=must_conditions)

        try:
            # Use query_points API
            results = await client.query_points(
                collection_name=self.collection_name,
                query=query_vector,
                limit=limit,
                score_threshold=score_threshold,
                query_filter=q_filter,
                with_payload=True,
            )

            chunks: list[DocumentChunk] = []
            for hit in results.points:
                payload = hit.payload or {}
                meta = dict(payload.get("metadata", {}))
                for k, v in payload.items():
                    if k not in ("title", "text", "metadata", "audio_url"):
                        meta[k] = v
                chunk = DocumentChunk(
                    id=str(hit.id),
                    title=str(payload.get("title", "")),
                    text=str(payload.get("text", "")),
                    score=float(hit.score if hit.score is not None else 0.0),
                    metadata=meta,
                    audio_url=payload.get("audio_url"),
                    vector_store=self.name,
                )
                chunks.append(chunk)

            return chunks
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [QdrantVectorStore] Search error on {self.collection_name}: {exc}")
            return []

    async def upsert(
        self,
        chunks: list[DocumentChunk],
        vectors: list[list[float]],
    ) -> None:
        """Upserts document chunks and embeddings into Qdrant in batches."""
        client = self._get_client()
        if client is None or qmodels is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Qdrant client not available for upsert.")

        await self.init_collection()

        points = [
            qmodels.PointStruct(
                id=c.id,
                vector=v,
                payload={
                    "title": c.title,
                    "text": c.text,
                    "audio_url": c.audio_url or "",
                    "metadata": c.metadata,
                    **c.metadata,
                },
            )
            for c, v in zip(chunks, vectors)
        ]

        batch_size = 50
        for i in range(0, len(points), batch_size):
            batch = points[i : i + batch_size]
            await client.upsert(collection_name=self.collection_name, points=batch)

    async def delete_points(self, point_ids: list[str]) -> int:

    if not point_ids or qmodels is None:

    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"⚠️  [QdrantVectorStore] Delete points error: {exc}")
        return 0

    async def get_stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Retrieves collection statistics (point counts, indexed vectors, dimension)."""
    client = self._get_client()
    if client is None or not await self.is_available():
        return {
            "status": "offline",
            "collection_name": self.collection_name,
            "points_count": 0,
            "vectors_count": 0,
        }
    try:
        info = await client.get_collection(collection_name=self.collection_name)
        points = getattr(info, "points_count", 0) or 0
        vectors = getattr(info, "indexed_vectors_count", points) or points
        vector_size = 768
        distance = "Cosine"
        try:
            if hasattr(info.config.params, "vectors"):
                v_params = info.config.params.vectors
                if hasattr(v_params, "size"):
                    vector_size = v_params.size
                if hasattr(v_params, "distance"):
                    distance = str(v_params.distance.value if hasattr(v_params.distance, "value") else v_params.distance)
        except Exception:
            pass

        return {
            "status": "online",
            "collection_name": self.collection_name,
            "points_count": points,
            "vectors_count": vectors,
            "vector_size": vector_size,
            "distance": distance,
        }
    except Exception as exc:
        return {"status": "error", "error": str(exc), "points_count": 0}

    async def init_collection(self, vector_size: int = 768, distance: str = "Cosine") -> bool:
    """Ensures the collection exists with the required vector dimension and distance metric."""
    client = self._get_client()
    if client is None or qmodels is None:
        return False
    try:
        collections = await client.get_collections()
        existing = [c.name for c in collections.collections]
        if self.collection_name not in existing:
            dist_metric = qmodels.Distance.COSINE
            if distance.lower() == "euclid":
                dist_metric = qmodels.Distance.EUCLID
            elif distance.lower() == "dot":
                dist_metric = qmodels.Distance.DOT

            await client.create_collection(
                collection_name=self.collection_name,
                vectors_config=qmodels.VectorParams(
                    size=vector_size,
                    distance=dist_metric,
                ),
            )
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"⚠️  [QdrantVectorStore] Collection init skipped/error: {exc}")
        return False

    async def is_available(self) -> bool:
    """Checks if Qdrant server is reachable and collection exists."""
    client = self._get_client()
    if client is None:
        return False
    try:
        collections = await client.get_collections()
        return any(c.name == self.collection_name for c in collections.collections)
    except Exception:
        return False

    async def search(
    self,
    query_vector: list[float],
    limit: int = 3,
    score_threshold: float = 0.5,
    filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
    """Executes vector similarity search on Qdrant collection."""
    client = self._get_client()
    if client is None:
        return []

    q_filter = None
    if filter_metadata and qmodels is not None:
        must_conditions: list[Any] = []
        should_conditions: list[Any] = []
        for k, v in filter_metadata.items():
            if isinstance(v, list):
                for item in v:
                    should_conditions.append(qmodels.FieldCondition(key=k, match=qmodels.MatchValue(value=item)))
            else:
                must_conditions.append(qmodels.FieldCondition(key=k, match=qmodels.MatchValue(value=v)))

        if must_conditions and should_conditions:
            q_filter = qmodels.Filter(must=must_conditions, should=should_conditions)
        elif should_conditions:
            q_filter = qmodels.Filter(should=should_conditions)
        elif must_conditions:
            q_filter = qmodels.Filter(must=must_conditions)

    try:
        # Use query_points API
        results = await client.query_points(
            collection_name=self.collection_name,
            query=query_vector,
            limit=limit,
            score_threshold=score_threshold,
            query_filter=q_filter,
            with_payload=True,
        )

        chunks: list[DocumentChunk] = []
        for hit in results.points:
            payload = hit.payload or {}
            meta = dict(payload.get("metadata", {}))
            for k, v in payload.items():
                if k not in ("title", "text", "metadata", "audio_url"):
                    meta[k] = v
            chunk = DocumentChunk(
                id=str(hit.id),
                title=str(payload.get("title", "")),
                text=str(payload.get("text", "")),
                score=float(hit.score if hit.score is not None else 0.0),
                metadata=meta,
                audio_url=payload.get("audio_url"),
                vector_store=self.name,
            )
            chunks.append(chunk)

        return chunks
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"⚠️  [QdrantVectorStore] Search error on {self.collection_name}: {exc}")
        return []

    async def upsert(
    self,
    chunks: list[DocumentChunk],
    vectors: list[list[float]],
) -> None:
    """Upserts document chunks and embeddings into Qdrant in batches."""
    client = self._get_client()
    if client is None or qmodels is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Qdrant client not available for upsert.")

    await self.init_collection()

    points = [
        qmodels.PointStruct(
            id=c.id,
            vector=v,
            payload={
                "title": c.title,
                "text": c.text,
                "audio_url": c.audio_url or "",
                "metadata": c.metadata,
                **c.metadata,
            },
        )
        for c, v in zip(chunks, vectors)
    ]

    batch_size = 50
    for i in range(0, len(points), batch_size):
        batch = points[i : i + batch_size]
        await client.upsert(collection_name=self.collection_name, points=batch)

    class PineconeVectorStore(BaseVectorStore):
    """
    Pinecone serverless cloud vector database store adapter.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        index_name: str = "knowledge-base",
        api_key: str | None = None,
        namespace: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        self.index_name = index_name
        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("PINECONE_API_KEY", "")
        self.namespace = namespace
        self._pc: Any = None
        self._index: Any = None
        self._avail_cache_value: bool | None = None
        self._avail_cache_ts: float = 0.0
        self._cache_ttl: float = 300.0

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return f"Pinecone ({self.index_name})"

    def _get_index(self) -> Any:
        if not PINECONE_AVAILABLE or Pinecone is None or not self.api_key:
            return None
        if self._index is None:
            # pyright: ignore[reportCallIssue]
            self._pc = Pinecone(api_key=self.api_key)  # type: ignore[call-arg]
            self._index = self._pc.Index(self.index_name)
        return self._index

    def invalidate_cache(self) -> None:
        """Clears availability cache."""
        self._avail_cache_value = None
        self._avail_cache_ts = 0.0

    async def is_available(self) -> bool:
        """Verifies connection to Pinecone cloud index with cached result."""
        if not PINECONE_AVAILABLE or Pinecone is None or not self.api_key:
            return False

        import time
        now = time.monotonic()
        if self._avail_cache_value is not None and (now - self._avail_cache_ts) < self._cache_ttl:
            return self._avail_cache_value

        def _check() -> bool:
            try:
                idx = self._get_index()
                if idx is None:
                    return False
                idx.describe_index_stats()
                return True
            except Exception:
                return False

        res = await asyncio.to_thread(_check)
        self._avail_cache_value = res
        self._avail_cache_ts = now
        return res

    async def get_stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Retrieves Pinecone index statistics."""
        if not self.api_key:
            return {"status": "offline", "index_name": self.index_name, "points_count": 0}

        def _do_stats() -> dict[str, Any]:
            idx = self._get_index()
            if idx is None:
                return {"status": "offline", "index_name": self.index_name, "points_count": 0}
            try:
                stats = idx.describe_index_stats()
                ns = stats.get("namespaces", {}).get(self.namespace, {})
                return {
                    "status": "online",
                    "index_name": self.index_name,
                    "namespace": self.namespace,
                    "vector_size": getattr(stats, "dimension", 768),
                    "points_count": ns.get("vector_count", 0),
                    "vectors_count": ns.get("vector_count", 0),
                    "total_vectors": stats.get("total_vector_count", 0),
                }
            except Exception as exc:
                return {"status": "error", "error": str(exc), "points_count": 0}

        return await asyncio.to_thread(_do_stats)

    async def delete_points(self, point_ids: list[str]) -> int:
        """Deletes specific vector IDs from Pinecone in batches."""
        if not point_ids or not self.api_key:
            return 0

        def _do_delete() -> int:
            idx = self._get_index()
            if idx is None:
                return 0
            batch_size = 100
            for i in range(0, len(point_ids), batch_size):
                batch = point_ids[i : i + batch_size]
                idx.delete(ids=batch, namespace=self.namespace)
            return len(point_ids)

        try:
            return await asyncio.to_thread(_do_delete)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [PineconeVectorStore] Delete points error: {exc}")
            return 0

    async def delete_by_filter(self, filter_metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Deletes all vectors in Pinecone matching metadata filter."""
        if not filter_metadata or not self.api_key:
            return False

        def _do_delete_filter() -> bool:
            idx = self._get_index()
            if idx is None:
                return False
            idx.delete(filter=filter_metadata, namespace=self.namespace)
            return True

        try:
            return await asyncio.to_thread(_do_delete_filter)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [PineconeVectorStore] Delete by filter error: {exc}")
            return False

    async def search(
        self,
        query_vector: list[float],
        limit: int = 3,
        score_threshold: float = 0.5,
        filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
        """Queries Pinecone index asynchronously via thread offload."""
        if not self.api_key:
            return []

        def _do_query() -> list[DocumentChunk]:
            idx = self._get_index()
            if idx is None:
                return []

            kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
                "vector": query_vector,
                "top_k": max(1, int(limit)),
                "include_metadata": True,
            }
            if self.namespace:
                kwargs["namespace"] = self.namespace
            if filter_metadata:
                kwargs["filter"] = filter_metadata

            results = idx.query(**kwargs)
            chunks: list[DocumentChunk] = []

            for match in getattr(results, "matches", []):
                score = float(match.get("score", 0.0) if isinstance(match, dict) else getattr(match, "score", 0.0))
                if score < score_threshold:
                    continue

                meta = match.get("metadata", {}) if isinstance(match, dict) else getattr(match, "metadata", {}) or {}
                chunk_id = str(match.get("id", "") if isinstance(match, dict) else getattr(match, "id", ""))

                chunks.append(
                    DocumentChunk(
                        id=chunk_id,
                        title=str(meta.get("title", "")),
                        text=str(meta.get("text", "")),
                        score=score,
                        metadata=meta,
                        audio_url=meta.get("audio_url"),
                        vector_store=self.name,
                    )
                )

            return chunks

        try:
            return await asyncio.to_thread(_do_query)
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [PineconeVectorStore] Search error on {self.index_name}: {exc}")
            return []

    async def upsert(
        self,
        chunks: list[DocumentChunk],
        vectors: list[list[float]],
    ) -> None:
        """Upserts vectors and metadata into Pinecone."""
        def _do_upsert() -> None:
            idx = self._get_index()
            if idx is None:
                raise RuntimeError("Pinecone index not initialized.")

            records = [
                {
                    "id": c.id,
                    "values": v,
                    "metadata": {
                        "title": c.title,
                        "text": c.text,
                        "audio_url": c.audio_url or "",
                        **c.metadata,
                    },
                }
                for c, v in zip(chunks, vectors)
            ]
            batch_size = 100
            for i in range(0, len(records), batch_size):
                batch = records[i : i + batch_size]
                idx.upsert(vectors=batch, namespace=self.namespace)

        await asyncio.to_thread(_do_upsert)

                    vector_store=self.name,
                )
            )

        return chunks

    try:
        return await asyncio.to_thread(_do_query)
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"⚠️  [PineconeVectorStore] Search error on {self.index_name}: {exc}")
        return []

    async def upsert(
    self,
    chunks: list[DocumentChunk],
    vectors: list[list[float]],
) -> None:
    """Upserts vectors and metadata into Pinecone."""
    def _do_upsert() -> None:
        idx = self._get_index()
        if idx is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Pinecone index not initialized.")

        records = [
            {
                "id": c.id,
                "values": v,
                "metadata": {
                    "title": c.title,
                    "text": c.text,
                    "audio_url": c.audio_url or "",
                    **c.metadata,
                },
            }
            for c, v in zip(chunks, vectors)
        ]
        batch_size = 100
        for i in range(0, len(records), batch_size):
            batch = records[i : i + batch_size]
            idx.upsert(vectors=batch, namespace=self.namespace)

    await asyncio.to_thread(_do_upsert)

    class BaseEmbeddingModel(ABC):
    """
    Abstract Base Class for text embedding generators.
    """

    @abstractmethod
    async def embed_text(self, text: str) -> list[float]:
        """Generates a dense vector embedding for a single text document."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def embed_query(self, query: str) -> list[float]:
        """Generates a dense vector embedding for a search query."""
        pass

    async def embed_texts(self, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        """Batch generates embeddings for multiple texts."""
        embeddings: list[list[float]] = []
        for t in texts:
            emb = await self.embed_text(t)
            embeddings.append(emb)
        return embeddings

    async def embed_batch(self, texts: list[str], batch_size: int = 20) -> list[list[float]]:
        """Alias for batched text embeddings generation."""
        return await self.embed_texts(texts)

    class GeminiEmbeddings(BaseEmbeddingModel):
    """
    Asynchronous embedding generator powered by Google Gemini API.
    Reuses persistent HTTP connections to eliminate TLS handshake latency on edge devices.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        api_key: str | None = None,
        model: str = "gemini-embedding-001",
        dimension: int = 768,
        timeout: float = 25.0,
    ) -> None:
        self.api_key = (api_key or os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY", "")).strip()
        self.model = model
        self.dimension = dimension
        self.timeout = timeout
        self._client: Any = None
        self._cache: dict[str, list[float]] = {}

    def _get_client(self) -> Any:
        if not HTTPX_AVAILABLE or httpx is None:
            raise RuntimeError("httpx is required for GeminiEmbeddings. Install with: pip install httpx")
        if self._client is None or self._client.is_closed:
            self._client = httpx.AsyncClient(
                timeout=self.timeout,
                http2=False,
                limits=httpx.Limits(max_keepalive_connections=5, max_connections=10),
            )
        return self._client

    async def embed_text(self, text: str) -> list[float]:
        """Generates embedding vector for a given text."""
        clean = (text or "").strip()
        if not clean:
            return [0.0] * self.dimension

        if clean in self._cache:
            return self._cache[clean]

        if not self.api_key:
            raise ValueError("Gemini API key is required for GeminiEmbeddings.")

        client = self._get_client()
        url = (
            f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{self.model}:embedContent"
            f"?key={self.api_key}"
        )
        payload = {
            "model": f"models/{self.model}",
            "content": {"parts": [{"text": clean}]},
            "outputDimensionality": self.dimension,
        }

        # Up to 2 retries on rate limits
        for attempt in range(2):
            try:
                resp = await client.post(url, json=payload)
                if resp.status_code == 200:
                    data = resp.json()
                    values = data.get("embedding", {}).get("values", [])
                    if values:
                        self._cache[clean] = values
                        if len(self._cache) > 200:
                            self._cache.pop(next(iter(self._cache)))
                        return values
                elif resp.status_code == 429 and attempt == 0:
                    await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
                    continue
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"Gemini embedding API error {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}")
            except Exception as exc:
                if attempt == 1:
                    raise exc
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

        return [0.0] * 768

    async def embed_query(self, query: str) -> list[float]:
        """Generates embedding vector for a search query."""
        return await self.embed_text(query)

    async def embed_batch(self, texts: list[str], batch_size: int = 20) -> list[list[float]]:
        """
        Generates dense vector embeddings for multiple texts using Gemini batchEmbedContents API.
        Includes automatic batch chunking, rate-limiting delays, and exponential backoff on HTTP 429.
        """
        if not texts:
            return []

        if not self.api_key:
            raise ValueError("Gemini API key is required for GeminiEmbeddings.")

        client = self._get_client()
        url = (
            f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{self.model}:batchEmbedContents"
            f"?key={self.api_key}"
        )
        all_embeddings: list[list[float]] = []
        total_batches = (len(texts) + batch_size - 1) // batch_size

        for b_idx, i in enumerate(range(0, len(texts), batch_size)):
            chunk = texts[i : i + batch_size]
            requests_payload = [
                {
                    "model": f"models/{self.model}",
                    "content": {"parts": [{"text": t.strip() if t.strip() else " "}]},
                    "outputDimensionality": 768,
                }
                for t in chunk
            ]

            if b_idx > 0:
                await asyncio.sleep(2.0)

            max_retries = 6
            batch_success = False

            for attempt in range(max_retries):
                try:
                    resp = await client.post(url, json={"requests": requests_payload})
                    resp.raise_for_status()
                    data = resp.json()
                    embeddings_list = data.get("embeddings", [])
                    for emb in embeddings_list:
                        all_embeddings.append(emb.get("values", [0.0] * 768))
                    batch_success = True
                    break
                except HTTPStatusError as exc:
                    resp_obj = getattr(exc, "response", None)
                    status_code = getattr(resp_obj, "status_code", 0) if resp_obj is not None else 0
                    if status_code == 429 and attempt < max_retries - 1:
                        headers = getattr(resp_obj, "headers", {}) or {}
                        retry_after = headers.get("retry-after")
                        if retry_after:
                            try:
                                wait_time = float(retry_after) + 1.0
                            except ValueError:
                                wait_time = (2 ** attempt) * 3.0 + 3.0
                        else:
                            wait_time = (2 ** attempt) * 3.0 + 3.0
                        print(f"⏳ [GeminiEmbeddings] Rate limit 429 on batch {b_idx + 1}/{total_batches}, waiting {wait_time:.1f}s...")
                        await asyncio.sleep(wait_time)
                        continue
                    raise exc
                except Exception as exc:
                    if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                        wait_time = (2 ** attempt) * 2.5
                        print(f"⚠️ [GeminiEmbeddings] Network error on batch {b_idx + 1}/{total_batches} ({exc}), retrying in {wait_time:.1f}s...")
                        await asyncio.sleep(wait_time)
                        continue
                    raise exc

            if not batch_success:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to generate embeddings for batch {b_idx + 1}/{total_batches} after {max_retries} retries.")

        return all_embeddings

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """Closes the underlying HTTP client."""
        if self._client and not self._client.is_closed:
            await self._client.aclose()
            self._client = None

    async def embed_text(self, text: str) -> list[float]:
    """Generates embedding vector for a given text."""
    clean = (text or "").strip()
    if not clean:
        return [0.0] * self.dimension

    if clean in self._cache:
        return self._cache[clean]

    if not self.api_key:
        raise ValueError("Gemini API key is required for GeminiEmbeddings.")

    client = self._get_client()
    url = (
        f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{self.model}:embedContent"
        f"?key={self.api_key}"
    )
    payload = {
        "model": f"models/{self.model}",
        "content": {"parts": [{"text": clean}]},
        "outputDimensionality": self.dimension,
    }

    # Up to 2 retries on rate limits
    for attempt in range(2):
        try:
            resp = await client.post(url, json=payload)
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                data = resp.json()
                values = data.get("embedding", {}).get("values", [])
                if values:
                    self._cache[clean] = values
                    if len(self._cache) > 200:
                        self._cache.pop(next(iter(self._cache)))
                    return values
            elif resp.status_code == 429 and attempt == 0:
                await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
                continue
            else:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Gemini embedding API error {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}")
        except Exception as exc:
            if attempt == 1:
                raise exc
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    return [0.0] * 768
